changelog: New voice command "select last line" — say it alone while dictating (or "শেষ লাইন সিলেক্ট করো" in Bengali) and the line right before the cursor is selected, so you can copy just that line or dictate the correction straight over a whole misheard line. It is the line-sized twin of v14.7's "select last sentence" and v14.8's "select last paragraph". The Help & Support Voice commands list now shows all 50 commands. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
